label: e01
title: Stats cram — walk-ins welcome
description: Bring whatever stats unit you are stuck on. Whiteboards booked, snacks shared. Stay 20 minutes or the whole night.

label: e02
title: Torrens riverbank walk + coffee
description: Easy 40-minute loop along the river, then coffee. Good way to meet people outside your degree.

label: e03
title: Board games & pizza night
description: Catan, Codenames and way too much pizza. $5 in at the door for food.

label: e04
title: International students cook-off
description: Bring a dish from home or just come hungry. Ingredients for a shared curry provided.

label: e05
title: Python help drop-in
description: Stuck on an assignment or a pandas error? Bring your laptop and your question. All levels welcome, first-years especially.

label: e06
title: Law exam prep circle
description: Contracts and torts past papers, then we compare answers. Adelaide and Flinders law students both welcome.

label: e07
title: Nursing clinical skills practice
placeName: Flinders City Campus, Level 3 study space
description: Practise obs, handover and med calcs before placement. Bring your own stethoscope if you have one.

label: e08
title: Sunset frisbee
description: Casual throw-around on the grass by the lake. Never played? Even better. Spare discs provided.

label: e09
title: Botanic Garden sketch walk
description: Slow walk with sketchbooks, stopping wherever looks good. Pencils and a few spare sketchbooks to share.

label: e10
title: Algorithms pair-programming night
description: Pair up on LeetCode-style problems or your COMP SCI assignment. Laptops out, no judgement.

label: e11
title: Language exchange: English ⇄ Mandarin & more
description: Half an hour in each language, then swap partners. Any language is welcome, we just split into tables.

label: e12
title: Picnic in Elder Park
description: Bring something to share and a picnic rug if you have one. Frisbee and cards if the weather holds.

label: e13
title: Central Market budget shop
placeName: Adelaide Central Market, Gouger St entrance
description: Split bulk buys and learn which stalls do the cheapest veg. Bring a bag and some cash.

label: e14
title: Vegan potluck
description: Bring a plant-based dish, or just bring a fork. We'll set up on the lawn near the fountain.

label: e15
title: Stats study group
description: Weekly catch-up for STAT and data units at Bedford Park. We book a room on the day; check the whiteboard at the entrance.

label: e16
title: Engineering maths catch-up
description: Linear algebra and calculus problem sets, worked through together. Mawson Lakes campus students welcome.
